description: (Na)₂NaYBr₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaYBr₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaYBr₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form NaBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent YBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Br bond lengths are 2.86 Å. Y is bonded to six equivalent Br atoms to form YBr₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaBr₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Y-Br bond lengths are 2.78 Å. Br is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Y atom.
